o: #Momtok is back, but damaging revelations and allegations threaten its future. The members face a crisis of friendship as loyalties shift, trust is tested, and the lines between fact and fiction blur. When the pursuit of the truth calls character into question, a war over morality begins and a clash between #Momtok and #Dadtok erupts. With their sisterhood and everything they've built hanging in…

eps.o: Scandal rocks #MomTok when accusations of a secret affair threaten relationships. Layla invites an unwelcome guest to a #MomTok party, and Demi and Whitney lurk in the shadows.
As a marriage unravels, Mikayla and Mayci set out to learn the truth about an affair. Taylor commits to new boundaries with Dakota, and Jen anxiously makes her return to Utah.
#MomTok learns that Demi may have been involved in exposing Jessi. Demi makes an unexpected appearance and goes head-to-head with Layla, and Jen nervously gears up for her reunion with the girls.

In the wake of a lie detector test, a toxic dynamic comes to light, creating a war between #MomTok and #DadTok. Jen returns to the group with a score to settle, and Layla's hair loss motivates her to make a big change.
The group's newfound peace is threatened when the ghost of #MomTok’s past returns in the form of Whitney, and reputations are publicly attacked. Mikayla confronts her painful past.
As #MomTok heads to Hollywood, a shocking allegation is made. The wedge between the group deepens, and Jessi and Demi face off.
#MomTok saddles up for Stagecoach, but their weekend takes a turn when a damning post threatens to destroy the group. Marital issues worsen while others rekindle romance.
Headlines make waves in Utah and suspicious receipts leave allegiances in question. Pieces of the past come to light, and a devastating secret is revealed.
A glitzy premiere goes off the rails, when behind the scenes drama erupts during press.
Righteous or revelatory? A shocking intervention calls for both the hot seat and the Holy Ghost.

'Tis the season for the most dramatic reunion yet! Host Stassi Schroeder reunites #MomTok and #DadTok to explore the shocking scandals, uncover never-before-seen footage, and deck the halls with controversial guests in the Season 3 Reunion.
